=== EMAIL to primary@example.com
Subject: Your permit “Visitor” expires on 24 Aug 2026
Provenance: You received this at primary@example.com because this address manages, or shares access to, a p.stonn account that schedules a visitor parking permit. p.stonn is a free, unofficial scheduler for City of Stonnington visitor parking permits.

Your permit “Visitor” is due to expire on 24 Aug 2026.

p.stonn keeps setting the rego, but it cannot renew the permit itself, so please renew it with the council to keep it valid. Once you renew, you can copy your schedule onto the new permit in p.stonn.

Open p.stonn: https://p.stonn.org
Renew with the council: https://parkingpermits.stonnington.vic.gov.au/ssp/
